topic_label: Commitment to integrity and ethical values
control_description: Code of conduct; POL-05 acknowledged at hire and each year; sanctions under POL-01 4.15
evidence: Code of conduct; acknowledgment report (96% of employees); sanctions log

control_description: Board audit committee receives quarterly cyber risk, POA&M, and PCI DSS status reports from the vCISO
evidence: Audit committee minutes (4 quarters to 2026-09-15); reporting calendar

control_description: vCISO, IT Director (PCI DSS technical lead), CFO (PCI DSS compliance owner), and system owners designated in writing in POL-01; reporting lines to the COO
Hiring, background checks for finance, IT, front office managers, and CRO agents; role-based security training
evidence: Background check records (25 sampled hires in P03); training completion (96%)
gap: No technical training plan for the IT team; the security function (Security Manager plus 1 analyst, part-time vCISO) has no documented capacity plan for the managed hotels
remediation: Training plan for IT staff; staffing review before 2027-01-01 with the REIT onboarding plan

control_description: Sanctions in POL-01 4.15; control owners named in the SSP and standards index
gap: Control owners have no security objectives in their annual goals; no evidence that control failures affect performance reviews
remediation: Add control-operation objectives to the goals of each standard owner and General Manager

control_description: Inventory of system components and data flows for the hotel management platform
gap: Inventory misses payment devices and Hotels 3 to 6 network components; PCI DSS scope and data flows not documented (P07 CM-8; P03 G-086)
remediation: Reconcile the inventory; scope document and data-flow diagrams (POAM-007, POAM-016)

topic_label: Internal communication of objectives and responsibilities
control_description: Policies (effective 2026-10-01) and standards communicated through the intranet, onboarding, and annual acknowledgment
evidence: POL-01 to POL-05; standards index; acknowledgment report
gap: 6 of 10 standards are drafts; runbooks not yet distributed to front offices and the CRO (P07 IR-8)
remediation: Issue standards on the P06 schedule; distribute runbooks (POAM-009)

control_description: Privacy notice, website terms, contracts with the REIT owner, the franchisor, and vendors; security contacts for owners and vendors
evidence: Privacy notice; REIT management agreement; franchise agreements
gap: Privacy notice says the company does not store card data and does not describe the chatbot or call analytics; no system description yet for the managed hotels' services (P03 G-089, G-090)
remediation: Rewrite the notice (POAM-018); draft the SOC 2 system description and owner-facing security commitments

topic_label: Objectives specified to enable risk identification
control_description: Risk appetite and objectives approved by the CEO; SOC 2 commitments to be added from the management agreement
Annual SP 800-30 risk assessment covering all business units, vendors, and AI
evidence: P01 risk register (52 risks) and report; P07 RA-3 fully satisfied

control_description: Fraud risk considered in the risk assessment (insider card theft, business email compromise)
gap: No structured fraud risk assessment of folio adjustments, refunds, rate overrides, or payroll changes for the managed hotels' accounting
remediation: Fraud risk assessment with the controller function; folio adjustment and refund reports reviewed monthly

control_description: Major changes trigger a risk review (POL-01 4.3); AI tools need approval (POL-01 4.13)
gap: 5 AI tools went live without review; onboarding the 2 managed hotels has no documented security review
remediation: Change triggers in STD-01 and STD-05; security review of the REIT onboarding plan (POAM-019)

control_description: Annual independent control assessment by the co-sourced internal audit firm; QSA-supported PCI DSS assessment; quarterly ASV scans
evidence: P07 assessment (32 controls, 206 statements); ASV reports for 4 quarters

control_description: Deficiencies tracked in the POA&M with owners and dates and reported quarterly to the audit committee
evidence: P07 poam.csv (21 items); audit committee minutes

topic_label: Control activities selected to mitigate risk
control_description: Controls selected from SP 800-53 Rev. 5 Moderate baseline with tailoring, mapped to risks
General IT controls over identity, configuration, change, backup, and monitoring
gap: No configuration baselines (STD-01 draft); 3 of 10 scanned servers missed required settings (P07 CM-6)
remediation: Issue STD-01 with baselines and drift reports (POAM-006)

topic_label: Control activities deployed through policies and procedures
control_description: Policies supported by standards and procedures
gap: Standards for logging, vendors, configuration, AI, and recovery are drafts
remediation: Issue on the P06 schedule

topic_label: Logical access security software, infrastructure, architecture
control_description: SSO and MFA for all corporate apps, email, cloud consoles, VPN, and SYS-01; privileged access broker for cloud and SYS-01 administration; encrypted cloud storage
evidence: Identity provider policy export; broker configuration; P04 control map
gap: Domain and server administrators outside the broker; Resort 2 POS VLAN can reach domain controllers (P07 AC-4, P01 R-009)
remediation: Broker for all administrators with phishing-resistant MFA; block POS VLAN directory traffic (POAM-003, POAM-004)

control_description: Accounts created through identity provider requests with manager approval
evidence: 25 of 25 sampled new SYS-01 accounts approved (P07 AC-2)

control_description: Role-based access in SYS-01 (31 roles); access reviews; removal at termination
evidence: SYS-01 permission export; review record (February 2026); P07 AC-2, AC-6, PS-4
gap: Reviews annual, not every 6 months; 5 of 25 transfers kept prior roles; 46 users can display full card numbers; shared night-audit login
remediation: 6-month reviews; transfer workflow; display rights cut to approved roles (POAM-001, POAM-002)

control_description: Badge access to the corporate office server room; badge access and CCTV at the resort server rooms
control_owner: Director of Loss Prevention and Safety
evidence: Badge reports; key logs at the resorts
gap: Network closets at Hotels 3 to 6 have no key log (P01 R-046); quarterly access list reviews not yet run
remediation: Key logs at all closets; quarterly reviews under STD-10

control_description: Certified destruction of media; disposal of paper and devices
gap: 2 leased copiers returned without a documented wipe (P07 MP-6)
remediation: Wipe certificate before any lease return (POAM-013)

topic_label: Protection against threats from outside boundaries
control_description: Firewalls at 7 sites, cloud firewall, ASV scans, VPN with MFA
gap: Vendor remote tools at Resort 2 without MFA; a known-exploited vulnerability on SD-WAN edge devices patched in 19 days (P07 AC-17, MA-4, RA-5)
remediation: Vendor access through the broker; 72-hour edge patch path (POAM-004, POAM-010)

topic_label: Restriction of data transmission and movement
control_description: TLS for data in transit; P2PE at resort front desks and Resort 1
gap: Card numbers and security codes in 2,860 emails and about 31,000 recordings; no data loss prevention rules (P07 SC-28)
remediation: Purge, data loss prevention, pause-and-resume recording (POAM-013)

topic_label: Prevention and detection of unauthorized or malicious software
control_description: EDR with 24x7 MSSP monitoring
evidence: EDR console (470 of 520 PCs); EICAR tests (5 of 5 quarantined)
gap: 50 PCs at Hotels 3 to 6 and 38 Resort 2 POS workstations without EDR (P07 SI-3)
remediation: EDR or allowlisting everywhere (POAM-014)

topic_label: Detection of configuration changes and vulnerabilities
control_description: Internal and ASV vulnerability scans; cloud posture monitoring
gap: Hotels 3 to 6 not scanned; no configuration drift detection (P07 RA-5, CM-6)
remediation: Monthly scans of all sites; drift reports (POAM-006, POAM-010)

topic_label: Monitoring for anomalies and security events
control_description: SIEM monitored 24x7 by the MSSP for identity, email, cloud, EDR, and firewalls
evidence: SIEM source list; MSSP monthly reports
gap: Resort 2 POS server, lock servers, and Hotels 3 to 6 not logged; CDE logs not reviewed daily (P07 AU-2, AU-6)
remediation: Onboard sources; automated daily review (POAM-005)

control_description: MSSP triage and escalation within 30 minutes; incident severity criteria in the P08 runbooks
evidence: Simulated sign-in escalated in 22 minutes (P07 SI-4); MSSP escalation records

control_description: Incident response policy and two runbooks with a notification matrix (P08)
gap: Runbooks untested and not yet distributed; lessons from the 2025 tabletop not implemented (P07 IR-4, IR-8)
remediation: Card compromise and ransomware tabletops; distribution (POAM-009)

control_description: Recovery from incidents using isolated, write-once backups
evidence: Backup reports (31 of 31 days); P07 CP-4, CP-9
gap: No restore test of the data warehouse or CRM; the lock server restore failed (P07 CP-4)
remediation: Quarterly restore tests with pass criteria (POAM-011)

control_description: Change tickets for cloud, firewall, and SYS-01 configuration changes, approved by the IT Director
evidence: 20 of 20 sampled cloud change tickets approved before release (P03 G-026)
gap: Resort 2 POS and lock vendors change systems without tickets; revenue-management rules and chatbot answer sources change without tickets or testing records
remediation: Vendor changes only through tickets and broker sessions; ticket revenue-management and chatbot changes with a test record

control_description: BIA (P05) recovery objectives; cyber insurance; hurricane plans
evidence: BIA report; insurance policy; hurricane plans
gap: SYS-01 contract has no recovery commitments; no IT section in Hotels 3 to 6 hurricane plans (P05)
remediation: Contract terms; hurricane plan IT sections (POAM-020)

topic_label: Vendor and business partner risk management
control_description: Vendor due diligence through the GRC Analyst; AOC and SOC 2 report collection
gap: 9 of 31 card and guest-data vendors without current AOC or SOC 2 report; no franchisor responsibility matrix (P07 SA-9)
remediation: STD-03; Tier 1 reviews; responsibility matrices (POAM-012)

control_description: Capacity monitored for SaaS services and cloud workloads; autoscaling for websites; SD-WAN bandwidth reports
Backups in a separate backup account in a second region with 35-day write-once retention; SaaS providers' environmental protections
gap: SYS-01 contract states no RTO or RPO; managed-hotel data flows not yet in the backup plan
remediation: SYS-01 recovery terms; add managed-hotel data to the backup plan before onboarding (POAM-020)

control_description: Recovery plan testing
gap: No recovery test of company-managed workloads has been performed
remediation: First quarterly restore test 2026-11-10; full CRO and data warehouse recovery exercise before the observation period (POAM-011)

topic_label: Identification and maintenance of confidential information
control_description: Data classification in POL-04; owner data for the managed hotels to be classified Confidential
gap: REIT owner data (rates, financials, guest data) not yet labeled or segregated in the data warehouse; card data outside the vault
remediation: Classify and tag owner data in the data warehouse and CRM; purge card data (POAM-013)

control_description: Disposal of confidential information at the end of retention
gap: Retention schedule not yet in force; ID scans and guest registers kept indefinitely (P03 G-100)
remediation: Configure deletion and purge the backlog (POAM-017)
